fieldDescription:
Controls the size and appearance of the Shore Leave status overlay on the campaign screen.

Compact: Sleek 39-character summary showing remaining days, -5% Upkeep, and +5% CR.
Minimal: Ultra-clean 18-character indicator with days remaining only.
Full: Detailed legacy line showing regional meal name and all 5 stats.
Off: Completely disables the campaign screen status overlay (Shore Leave remains fully active and viewable in the Fleet Log Intel directory).
Highlights the remaining time in red/orange when Shore Leave has less than 24 hours remaining.
Gently fades out the HUD hint upon expiry rather than instantly disappearing.
